title: Choose the visual world for getgymledger.com
question: The roll assigned The Gym Whiteboard. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Gym Whiteboard
options.lineage: The class board on every gym wall: today's session in marker, PRs listed underneath
options.thesis: The page is the board you read before you lift: today's workout in red marker, erased and rewritten as you scroll.
options.viewport: A full-width board: TODAY: PULL in huge red marker, the four exercises written underneath, a real iPhone held on by magnets showing the dashboard, and the App Store button sitting in the marker tray.
options.risk: Marker lettering turns cute or kid-like if it is set timidly or uses a novelty handwriting font.

raised.raise: The day's word (PUSH, PULL, LEGS) is written enormous and never shrinks at any breakpoint.
One gesture rules the page: an eraser swipe that turns one day's board into the next.
States are written on the board as marker notes and tallies, never as chrome badges.
The board's faint printed grid governs every alignment on the page.
Recovery reads as a dated countdown on the board: 'chest fresh in 22 h', ticked off as it clears.

options.label: The Anatomy Wall Chart
options.lineage: The muscle poster pinned up in every gym
options.thesis: The gym's muscle poster, coloured in by your own training: the recovery map is the hero.
options.viewport: Front and back figures at poster scale, muscles filled fresh, recovering or fatigued, with labelled leader lines out to the features.
options.risk: Familiar territory for a recovery-led fitness app, and it needs a fully authored anatomy illustration to avoid clip-art.

options.label: Vertical Feed
options.thesis: The training loop as a feed: one full-screen app moment per snap: log, recover, eat.
options.viewport: The dashboard fills the viewport at phone scale, caption low left, a rail of actions on the right, the next screen one snap below.
options.case: Lifters live in gym reels, so identification is high; clarity suffers because desktop visitors get a phone-shaped feed with hijacked scroll.
options.risk: Scroll-snap paging fights reading on desktop and can feel like a gimmick.

options.label: Info-Noise Sleeve
options.thesis: Plate codes, warning glyphs and one shouting word.
options.viewport: A black field of codes with one condensed word shouting through.
options.case: Lifters don't read design-culture noise, and the noise hides the app.
options.risk: Hostile to the reader the page has to convert.
options.kept: The one enormous word that never shrinks.

options.label: Drawcord Cape
options.thesis: One pull turns a flat plane into a shaped volume.
options.viewport: A black semicircle that gathers as you pull a cord.
options.case: No link to the gym or to logging; luxury register is wrong for lifters.
options.kept: One gesture transforms the whole surface.

options.label: Brine Calendar
options.lineage: Pickling jars on a seasonal shelf
options.thesis: Things mature visibly, day by day.
options.viewport: A shelf of jars, each labelled with a day count.
options.case: Only the recovery countdown fuses; food jars confuse a training app.
options.kept: State that matures on a visible day count.

options.label: Phosphor Terminal
options.thesis: The log as a live transcript on glass.
options.viewport: An 80-column transcript printing sets as they are logged.
options.case: Developer nostalgia, not gym culture; hides the real app screens.
options.kept: System states print themselves instead of appearing as chrome.

options.label: ASCII Render
options.thesis: A lifter rendered in glyph density.
options.viewport: A rotating barbell made of characters.
options.case: Clever, but neither lifters nor the product live in it.
options.kept: One strict grid as the whole composition.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A dark fitness-app site with phone mockups and a feature grid, done at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Headline and App Store button left, two phones right, features in a grid below.
canonCard.risk: Looks like Hevy, Strong and every other tracker by design.
